answer: My answer is a single mechanism: answers stay sealed until the epoch closes, so copies cannot be made from other submissions inside the same window. Every step lands on a public ledger and can be replayed by anyone. Farming therefore becomes a balance-sheet loss rather than a shortcut. The moral is closer to a short marble than to a firewall: trust gets retold, never bought. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a sparrow of small steps that each agent re-checks. Call it a cipher: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips.
